notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for hierarchy-aware object registration, discovery, lookup, callback-time subscription eligibility, and invalid-boundary behavior. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. It verifies standard object identity and discovery behavior without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class/attribute lookup, publication, subscription, registration, identity lookup, federation membership, callback servicing, and disconnect declarations with FederateAmbassador discovery callback
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador object registration and discovery declarations and FederateAmbassador callback
